# ForgeSworn on GitHub

> Public project catalogue for ForgeSworn’s open-source Nostr, Lightning, privacy and developer tools.

## Documentation

- [Organisation profile](https://github.com/forgesworn/.github/blob/main/profile/README.md): Project overviews grouped by what they do.
- [Machine-readable catalogue](https://github.com/forgesworn/.github/blob/main/forgesworn-repos.json): Repository links, categories and dependencies.

## ForgeSworn ecosystem

- [ForgeSworn library guide](https://forgesworn.dev/llms.txt): Find related libraries, tools and integration guides by task and runtime.
- [ForgeSworn on GitHub](https://github.com/forgesworn): Browse the organisation’s public repositories.
